knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=In summarize_transitions, determines how multiple transitions are summarized ("average" or "highest intensity" / "max") ;; measure=In normalization and differential analysis, specifies the intensity measure to use (e.g., "Area" or "Height") ;; exclude=In normalization, specifies sample types to exclude (e.g., "blank" to automatically detect and exclude blank runs) ;; log=In normalization and plotting, logical indicating whether to log-transform the data ;; method=In mva, specifies the multivariate analysis method ("PCA", "PCoA", "OPLS", or "OPLS-DA") ;; group_col=In mva, specifies the column name in colData used for grouping in supervised analysis ;; groups=In mva, specifies the specific group levels to compare ;; rank.by=In lsea, specifies the metric to rank lipids by (e.g., "logFC" or "p-value") ;; annotation=In plot_enrichment, specifies the lipid property to highlight (e.g., "class", "unsat", or "length")
- alternatives: normalize_pqn vs normalize_istd=Use normalize_pqn for general dilution correction when internal standards are not available; use normalize_istd to correct lipid class-specific variations using corresponding internal standards ;; de_analysis vs de_design=Use de_analysis for simple pairwise contrasts; use de_design for complex experimental designs requiring design matrices or formulas (e.g., factor adjustments or interactions)
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have targeted lipidomics data exported from Skyline and want to perform a complete downstream analysis workflow including QC, normalization, multivariate statistics, differential expression, and lipid set enrichment.
- pitfalls: Skyline exports must include Transition Results (or peak Area/Height) and replicates must either be exported or the "Pivot Replicate Name" option must be used ;; Differential analysis functions (de_analysis and de_design) require the limma package to be installed ;; Data must be normalized and log-transformed prior to differential analysis ;; If no corresponding internal standard is found during normalize_istd, the average of all measured internal standards is used instead

workflows.name: lipidomics_analysis_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform a complete downstream lipidomics analysis from Skyline CSV files, including QC, normalization, multivariate analysis, differential expression, and lipid set enrichment analysis.
input: data.csv (Skyline exported transition results CSV files)
clin.csv (Sample annotation CSV file containing sample names and clinical variables)
workflows.stages: 1. Import Skyline CSV files using read_skyline ;; 2. Add sample annotations using add_sample_annotation ;; 3. Subset data by selecting specific rows (lipids) and columns (samples) if necessary ;; 4. Perform raw data quality checks using plot_samples, plot_molecules, and plot_lipidclass ;; 5. Summarize multiple transitions per lipid molecule using summarize_transitions ;; 6. Normalize data using normalize_pqn or normalize_istd ;; 7. Perform multivariate analysis (PCA or OPLS-DA) using mva and visualize with plot_mva, plot_mva_loadings, or top_lipids ;; 8. Perform differential expression analysis using de_analysis (or de_design for complex designs) and visualize with plot_results_volcano ;; 9. Perform lipid set enrichment analysis (LSEA) using lsea and visualize with plot_enrichment and plot_chain_distribution
workflows.code:
datadir = system.file("extdata", package="lipidr")
filelist = list.files(datadir, "data.csv", full.names = TRUE) # all csv files
d = read_skyline(filelist)
print(d)

clinical_file = system.file("extdata", "clin.csv", package="lipidr")
d = add_sample_annotation(d, clinical_file)
colData(d)

d_subset = d[1:10, 1:10]
rowData(d_subset)
colData(d)

d_qc = d[, d$group == "QC"]
rowData(d_qc)
colData(d_qc)

pc_lipids = rowData(d)$Class %in% c("PC", "PCO", "PCP")
d_pc = d[pc_lipids,]
rowData(d_pc)
colData(d_pc)

lipid_classes = rowData(d)$Class %in% c("Cer", "PC", "LPC")
groups = d$BileAcid != "DCA"
d = d[lipid_classes, groups]
d_qc = d[, d$group == "QC"]

plot_samples(d, type = "tic", log = TRUE)
plot_molecules(d_qc, "sd", measure = "Retention Time", log = FALSE)
plot_molecules(d_qc, "cv", measure = "Area")
plot_lipidclass(d, "boxplot")

d_summarized = summarize_transitions(d, method = "average")

d_normalized = normalize_pqn(d_summarized, measure = "Area", exclude = "blank", log = TRUE)
plot_samples(d_normalized, "boxplot")

mvaresults = mva(d_normalized, measure="Area", method="PCA")
plot_mva(mvaresults, color_by="group", components = c(1,2))

mvaresults = mva(d_normalized, method = "OPLS-DA", group_col = "Diet", groups=c("HighFat", "Normal"))
plot_mva(mvaresults, color_by="group")
top_lipids(mvaresults, top.n=10)

de_results = de_analysis(
  data=d_normalized, 
  HighFat_water - NormalDiet_water,
  measure="Area"
)
head(de_results)
significant_molecules(de_results)
plot_results_volcano(de_results, show.labels = FALSE)

enrich_results = lsea(de_results, rank.by = "logFC")
significant_lipidsets(enrich_results)

plot_enrichment(de_results, significant_lipidsets(enrich_results), annotation="class")
plot_enrichment(de_results, significant_lipidsets(enrich_results), annotation="unsat")
plot_chain_distribution(de_results)
